title.narrative: Improving tuberculosis control and strengthen health systems in Niger - Niger (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Niger, Tuberculosis, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: Reduce tuberculosis mortality by 30 percent by 2018, in comparison with 2013 levels. The objectives of this program are: Detect a total of 50,520 cases of tuberculosis, all forms. Improve the quality of the program's management and coordination.. Increase the proportion of the population with knowledge, attitudes and practices that are favorable to tuberculosis control by 20 percent.. Raise the MDR-TB testing rate among re-treatment cases to at least 70 percent. Strengthen the capacity of health care staff and facilities to manage tuberculosis, malaria and AIDS.. Successfully treat at least 85 percent of tuberculosis cases, all forms.. Test at least 90 percent of tuberculosis cases for HIV, start 90 percent of patients coinfected with TB/HIV on co-trimoxazole and start 70 percent on antiretrovirals

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for NER-T-SCFP01
Percentage of reporting units reporting no stock-outs of anti-TB drugs on the last day of the quarter
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment
Percentage of bacteriologically confirmed TB cases successfully treated (cured plus completed treatment) among the bacteriologically confirmed TB cases registered during a specified period
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Number of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed TB, new and relapses
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
DOTS-other 1: Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among people deprived of liberty

PSM-other 1: Number and percentage of IHCs reporting no stock-outs lasting more than 7 days of one of the essential tracer drugs (ACT, quinine salts, cotrimoxazole, paracetamol, ORS, oxytocin, injectable ampicillin, injectable diazepam, misoprostol)

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Number of children <5 in contact with TB patients who began isonizide preventive therapy
HSS SD-other 1 : Number and percentage of blood bags tested for markers (HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B and C)
Impact indicators targets and results for NER-T-SCFP01
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
TB I-Other: Notification rates of bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB cases (new and recurrences) per 100,000 inhabitants
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
Outcome indicators targets and results for NER-T-SCFP01
TB O-Other 1: Rates of use of curative treatment
Treatment success rate - bacteriologically confirmed TB cases
